messages:
emily: Heads-up — I found a partner error log with a KMS-wrapped blob and a short-lived grant id. Not pasting the raw wrapped_blob here. Uploaded full copy to the secure bucket and DM'd sec.
emily: sanitized snippet (shared in #sec-private):
```
2026-03-22T14:01:58Z ERROR partner-proxy: request failed grant_id=ghr-3a2b partner=acme-inc wrapped_blob=<REDACTED> src_ip=18.206.23.11
```
josh: don't paste partner creds in public channels, thx. @emily can you confirm you uploaded to the private bucket and added ACL for sec oncall? :eyes:
emily: yep — s3://redwood-sec-ops/incidents/4765436789/log-full.txt (access granted to sec-oncall role). DM'ed the raw log to @josh and @liam.
maya: oncall here. I'm checking whether ghr-3a2b is still active in KMS audit. pinging KMS audit service.
devops-bot: KMS-AUDIT: grant=ghr-3a2b created=2026-03-22T02:02:12Z principal=serviceAccount:partner-proxy@acme scope=decrypt ttl=12h last_used=2026-03-22T14:01:58Z src_ip=18.206.23.11
liam: ok. plan proposal: revoke the grant first, stop further decrypts; then block partner SA on IAM edge; then decide on CMK rotation based on evidence of exfiltration. Re-encrypting existing objects is high cost.
olivia: I'll revoke now and confirm. Command I'm using (internal): `kmsctl revoke-grant --grant ghr-3a2b --key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr-1/cryptoKeys/ck-main` — will post audit id after.
josh: also need a hotfix to stop logging `wrapped_blob` entirely. quick grep: `kubectl -n partner logs | grep wrapped_blob` — @emily can you open a PR to mask that value? :arrow_up_small:
emily: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-proxy/pull/4567 — masks wrapped_blob and scrubs logs at the source. patch description attached in the PR.
maya: agree with liam: revoke + patch first. If we see decrypt requests from new IPs or unknown principals within 72h, escalate to full CMK rotate and re-encrypt backlog.
liam: revocation executed. Audit id `audit-0a1b2c3d`. KMS reports revoke success and subsequent decrypt attempts are failing with PERMISSION_DENIED. Also flagged the partner SA in IAM; temporarily removed its decrypt permission.
olivia: deployment notes: PR #4567 merged, images rolled out to partner-proxy, 3/3 pods updated. Verified logs no longer contain wrapped_blob. Deployed at 14:12Z.
emily: told partner SOC to rotate any keys on their side and to confirm whether that grant id was legitimately requested by them. Asked for timeline + evidence of exfil if any.
josh: create a short incident page in #postmortems once we gather audit logs for 48h. Include: initial detection, grant revoke audit id, PR link, partner correspondence notes.
carmen-legal: cc @carmen-legal — please do not notify external users yet. We need an incident summary and PII exposure assessment before any partner disclosure. Legal will coordinate with partner counsel if we confirm exposure.
liam: monitoring: set KMS audit retention to 1y for this CMK and enabled real-time alert on unknown IP decrypt attempts. Also opened a follow-up ticket to evaluate masking libraries in partner-proxy (priority: must not log envelope values).
emily: closing loop for now — grant revoked, patch merged, partner SOC engaged, legal looped. We'll keep this thread open for the 72h observation window and then draft the postmortem.
josh: thanks everyone. small ask: add a checklist item to incident playbook to validate "no envelope blobs logged" during code reviews.
maya: noted — putting that in the runbook. Will update runbook PR after this.
olivia: confirm final: revoke audit id `audit-0a1b2c3d`, deployment PR #4567, partner asked to rotate SA keys, legal holding on external disclosure. I'll post final status at 2026-03-25T14:12Z unless anything changes.
